title: Crime and Peter Chambers
paragraphs: A hard-boiled detective series based on Henry Kane's private eye Peter Chambers, following the New York investigator through murder cases and underworld entanglements.

NBC sustaining private-detective series based on Henry Kane’s pre-existing Peter Chambers character. Historical numbering preserves missing programs #8 (May 25) and #10 (June 8) rather than compressing the sequence.
The run breaks into several distinct periods: 23-broadcast NBC run (April 6, 1954 to September 7, 1954) on [[org|org.f2f0561f0ce2ddc5|NBC Radio Network]].

Names that turn up again and again in the surviving run include [[person|dane-clark|Dane Clark]] (performer), Fred Collins (announcer), Fred Weihe (director and transcriber), Henry Kane (producer, writer, and creator), William Zuckert (performer), Donald Buka (performer), and Lesley Woods (performer).
Across its run, the surviving broadcasts are tied to [[org|org.f2f0561f0ce2ddc5|NBC Radio Network]].

The stories often return to private detective investigation, New York City crime and nightlife, murder and suspicious death, private detective and police cooperation, clubs, ballrooms and entertainment venues, and embezzlement, inheritance and financial motive.

The show also sits in a wider radio history that includes Henry Kane brings his literary detective to radio, 1954 NBC sustaining private-eye series, 23 broadcasts, 21 surviving, and OTRR/GRH reference material in archive container.
